headline: Czech National Bank Raises Benchmark Interest Rate
summary: The Czech National Bank hiked its main interest rate for the second time this year on November 5, describing the move as a fine-tuning of its restrictive monetary policy.
why: The Czech National Bank sets monetary policy for the Czech Republic to maintain price stability and manage inflationary pressures.

impacts.name: Czech Interest Rate
impacts.why: The central bank implemented a rate hike to reinforce restrictive monetary policy against inflation.
